I am a freelance researcher with expertise in survey development, data processing, and data visualization. I received a PhD in Psychology from the University of Texas at Austin in 2025.

During my PhD, my primary research was on people's opinions on the origin of SARS-CoV-2. My recent [publication](https://online.ucpress.edu/collabra/article/12/1/155621/217108) demonstrated that groups of individuals have varying beliefs where the virus originated across 11 countries.

My interest has shifted towards psychological measurement and how to improve methodological approaches to better understand human attitudes and behavior.

## Other Interests

Since Feburary 2024, I have been learning Mandarin-Chinese and can read simplified and traditional characters. I also have a Chinese name: 游昊茗
